# Follow current POP sink ownership instead of the old URL documentation

The documentation landing described the historical sink as owned by a POP URL. That ownership statement is absent from the accepted IDL. Current Pop3Client creates a sink, assigns its server and destination folder, and can replace it with a supplied sink when fetching a body by UIDL. Pop3Service obtains clients for requests. Teach this current ownership path, not the retired native URL model. The current callback lifecycle remains a separate per-download and per-message contract. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: POP sink owner migration.
